page.purpose: The title block's title, one per page.

section.purpose: Section headings below a hairline rule.

dense.purpose: Table cells, controls and form text: the working size of the app.

legend.purpose: Title-block labels and table headers only; uppercase, condensed.

data.purpose: Ids, resource names, code, log lines, query results.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, dialogs, sheets, and a dragged row while it moves.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Elements that move between two places on screen.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Side sheets sliding in from the right.

motion.name: dur-press
motion.purpose: Button press scale to 97% and back.

motion.name: dur-tip
motion.purpose: Tooltip entrance; later tooltips in a row appear at once.

motion.name: dur-menu
motion.purpose: Menu and popover entrance; exits take 100ms.

motion.name: dur-ink
motion.purpose: The construction tint fading off a value that just changed.

components.name: Commit Button
components.description: The one committing control of a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-commit { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--commit); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--commit); color: var(--commit-ink); font: 500 13px/18px var(--font-ui); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-commit:hover { background: var(--commit-hover); border-color: var(--commit-hover); } .ds-btn-commit:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-commit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Confirms a destruction, after the resource name is typed.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--redline); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--redline); color: var(--commit-ink); font: 500 13px/18px var(--font-ui); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--redline-hover); border-color: var(--redline-hover); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every action that is not the commit.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--sheet); color: var(--ink); font: 500 13px/18px var(--font-ui); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--hover); border-color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); font: 500 12px/16px var(--font-ui); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, help below; machine values in the data font.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 360px; } .ds-field-label { font: 500 13px/18px var(--font-ui); color: var(--ink); } .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--sheet); color: var(--ink); font: 400 12px/16px var(--font-code); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-help { font: 400 12px/16px var(--font-ui); color: var(--ink-3); }

components.name: Status Glyph
components.description: State as an icon and a word, never color alone.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 400 13px/18px var(--font-ui); color: var(--ink); } .ds-status-ok svg { color: var(--ok); }

components.name: Title Block
components.description: The head of every page: title, status, actions and cells, like a drawing title block.
components.css: .ds-title { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--film); } .ds-title-row { padding: 20px 24px 12px; } .ds-title h1 { margin: 0; font: 600 20px/28px var(--font-ui); letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--ink); } .ds-title-sub { font: 400 13px/18px var(--font-ui); color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-cells { display: flex; margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-cells > div { padding: 8px 24px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-cells dt { font: 560 11px/14px var(--font-ui); font-stretch: 75%; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-cells dd { margin: 0; font: 400 12px/16px var(--font-code); color: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview:
Every Google Cloud resource is a drawing sheet. A title block states what the resource is and under which credential; a revision table says what changed; redline marks what is wrong or about to be destroyed. The world is drafting film with graphite ink and hairline rules, with non-repro blue for construction lines and secondary information. The dark theme is a blueprint: the same drawing, reversed onto deep navy.

The interface is dense inside a block and generous between blocks, and it is never boxed into cards. It is used for hours, mostly by keyboard, often during incidents, so it stays calm: one saturated color per view, and that color means "commit". Status always carries an icon and a word, never color alone. Project data is drawn as text, exactly as Google returned it.

Ink settles; it does not fly. Values that change live take a pale construction tint that fades over a second. Popups grow from their trigger at 97% scale; nothing a keyboard triggers animates.
keyCharacteristics: Drafting film and graphite in light; blueprint navy in dark. Both are first-class, and both pass WCAG 2.2 AA.
Hairline rules instead of boxes and shadows; depth only for things that float (menus, dialogs, sheets).
One commit control per view, in commit blue; destruction in redline, behind a typed confirmation.
Archivo for every role; Martian Mono only for ids, paths, code and data.
Condensed uppercase legends label title blocks and table headers, like drafting lettering.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Commit blue appears on at most one control per view. A second action is secondary or ghost. A dialog or sheet is its own view and may have its own commit.

rules.name: The Redline Rule
rules.body: Red means an error or a destruction, nothing else. A red badge for "new" or a red brand accent is forbidden.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Colors exist only as tokens in `tokens.css`; Tailwind's default palette is removed, and a check fails the build on any other color literal.

rules.name: The Identity Is Not State Rule
rules.body: Profile color tags mark which credential is active; they never signal health.

rules.name: The Legend Rule
rules.body: Uppercase condensed lettering is reserved for legends. Buttons, headings and body text are sentence case.

rules.name: The Machine Text Rule
rules.body: If Google produced it (an id, a path, a JSON value), it is set in Martian Mono and drawn as text, never as HTML.

rules.name: The No Cards Rule
rules.body: Content is never wrapped in raised cards. A group is a section with a heading and a rule.

dos: **Do** keep one commit-blue control per view and make every other action secondary or ghost.
**Do** pair every state color with its icon and a word.
**Do** set ids, paths, code and values in Martian Mono, as text, exactly as Google returned them.
**Do** put a typed confirmation of the resource name in front of every destruction, with the equivalent command shown.
**Do** use the non-repro tint, fading over one second, to show that a live value just changed.
**Do** honor reduced motion: popups keep their fade, lose their scale; spinners stop.
donts: **Don't** use red for anything but errors and destruction.
**Don't** wrap content in cards, add colored top bars, or build dashboards of metric tiles.
**Don't** animate anything triggered by a keyboard shortcut or repeated many times a minute.
**Don't** grow a popup from 0 or from the center of the screen; it grows from its trigger at 97%.
**Don't** add a color outside `tokens.css`, or reuse a profile tag color to mean state.
**Don't** imitate Google's visual identity or use Google's product icons.
